findings.summary: Removed the dead asset-root reachability scan and cached answer.
Centralized native Promise return normalization while retaining recursive-callback behavior.
Consolidated shadow-generator light identity into its internal record and preserved public manifest shape.
Computed effective GPU instancing once for CLI composition and build options.
Derived trimmed SDL variant paths and provenance from one ordered feature list.
Shared canonical typed-array validation for storage buffers and non-U8 lowering.
Reused predeclared shader program normalization with preserved copies and empty fields.
Shared binary Vec3 component generation between value and ToRef intrinsics.
Centralized default sampler declarations across normalization, prelude and shader IR.
Shared scene-set restart policy across both backend frame boundaries.
Shared the diagnostic UI replay mouse identity.
Removed temporary surface tracing and repaired mechanically renamed prose.
Reused the existing HTML replacement helper for entity normalization.
Indexed static markup descendants by owner.
Made CSM callback registries lazy with weak identity-based disposers and capture release.
Made mirrored-mesh watchers weakly retain scene state.
Unified host selector validation, CSS projection and native kinds through one descriptor; normalized legacy classStyles input.
Shared the supported-backdrop predicate between CSS audit and lowering.
Lowered look-direction quaternion math from the pinned source and added numerical equivalence fixtures including degenerate inputs.
Replaced native dispatch vector copying with copy-on-write membership snapshots, preserving nested mutation and closure identity.
Cached gamepad button handles and unchanged axes with copy-on-change retained snapshots and stable hotplug indices.
Cached Dawn thin-pick bindings by all referenced resource identities and byte range, with pre-release invalidation.
Reduced backdrop copies to sampled regions, made FP16 pipelines lazy, used bounded stack clipping and cached Gaussian kernels.
Cached gradient candidate discovery and parsed parameters; skipped static/unchanged color work without excluding unbound innerHTML descendants.
Consolidated gradient kind/repetition/stop state and reused existing Unicode, string and color helpers.
Shared Dawn UI texture ownership and moved SDL frame texture creation into the existing common backend helper.
Corrected explicit RmlUi package selection to replace stale CMake cache paths.
Replace native capture-frame compensation with aligned publication timing.
findings.blockedBy: Paired callback/upload/capture traces and an aligned resource-publication contract are still needed; reordering renderer callbacks changes behavior.

findings.summary: Generalize equal horizontal panes to arbitrary retained canvas geometry.
findings.blockedBy: The primary canvas has no retained UI handle and there is no CSS-layout-to-drawable geometry contract or resize coverage; auxiliary rectangles alone cannot supply it.

findings.summary: Batch SDL storage publication across scene graphs.
findings.blockedBy: A validated multi-scene/custom-shadow resource-order schedule is required before uploads or callbacks can move across graph boundaries.

findings.summary: Centralized SceneNode transform descriptors across reads, component writes, set calls and generated bridge dispatch.
Feature-gated SceneNode transform bridge emission on actual source reachability.
Dispatched SceneNode component writes once with preserved target and compound-read sequencing.
Preserved live TransformNode GPU-transform updates and traversed imported-root dependents once for whole-vector writes.
Consolidated numeric typed-array, vector, ordinary-array and U8 full-fill overloads into one range-based implementation.
Kept native mesh CPU-array producers as vectors, avoiding a redundant temporary typed-array allocation before boundary conversion.
Computed Dawn graph view-projection lazily for geometry consumers while retaining the shared surface extent for render tasks.
Memoized native reference-storage demand by coalesced native struct identity and reused the parameter TypeScript type.
Named the native storage-demand predicate for both parameter and return consumers instead of its former return-only role.
Lazily loaded Dawn custom fragment modules only on first color-pipeline use.
Avoided temporary escaped markup for ordinary text, skipped ASCII decoding, and lazily expanded owned emoji markup only on change.
Reused the resolved system symbol face when the color emoji font is unavailable.
Used the canonical class registry query for plain-record eligibility.
Flattened JSON-array and numeric-tuple observer adaptation into the shared collection path.
Selected a whole reference-record home before scalar/container boxing, preserving compile-time JSON and callback/accessor paths.
Resolved async record return storage with existing Promise normalization and moved fresh reference results into their owning bindings.
